svg.title: Toolbox
svg.desc: AI & LLMs: Gemini API, Claude API, Groq API, LangGraph, Qdrant · RAG, Prompt engineering. Data & ML: pandas, NumPy, Streamlit, Folium, seaborn, TF-IDF, BigQuery. Mobile: React Native, Expo Router, EAS Build, Reanimated, NFC, Speech & TTS. Edge · now: ESP32, C/C++, PlatformIO, emlearn, LoRa, Raspberry Pi.
